note: Seeded factual problems the facts brief names: unsourced statistics, overstated causal claims, numbers or dates that contradict each other, unattributed quotations, and record or consensus claims with no source. Each document also carries sourced, hedged claims a precise reviewer should leave alone; library-evening-hours-strong.md is a decoy with every claim sourced and hedged.

hybrid-schedule-memo.md.quote: cut ticket resolution time by a third
hybrid-schedule-memo.md.issue: The summary's headline claim contradicts the pilot data below it: 6.2 to 5.4 hours is a cut of about 13%, not a third.

hybrid-schedule-memo.md.quote: Hybrid schedules are now the industry standard
hybrid-schedule-memo.md.issue: A consensus claim (industry standard, nearly every firm in the region) with no source.

hybrid-schedule-memo.md.quote: Remote workers are 23% more productive than office workers.
hybrid-schedule-memo.md.issue: A precise statistic with no source or citation.

hybrid-schedule-memo.md.quote: Our own pilot proves that working from home always improves focus.
hybrid-schedule-memo.md.issue: Overstated causal claim ("proves", "always"); the pilot measured resolution time, not focus.
A quotation attributed to an unnamed researcher with no source.

hybrid-schedule-memo.md.quote: the first in the country to run a fully paperless dispatch desk
hybrid-schedule-memo.md.issue: A record ("first in the country") claim with no source.

hybrid-schedule-memo.md.quote: 1 April: the new schedule starts for all operations staff.
hybrid-schedule-memo.md.issue: The timeline's start date conflicts with the summary, which says the schedule starts on 7 April 2025.

fenwick-street-notice.md.issue: Boiling does not remove lead (it can concentrate it), so the after-work safety advice rests on a wrong claim and must be rewritten.

fenwick-street-notice.md.quote: Lead exposure always causes lasting learning problems in children.
fenwick-street-notice.md.issue: Overstated causal claim ("always") with no source.

fenwick-street-notice.md.quote: Nationally, about one home in five still gets its water through a lead line.
fenwick-street-notice.md.issue: A national statistic with no source.

fenwick-street-notice.md.quote: Marrowbank also has the oldest water system in the state
fenwick-street-notice.md.issue: A record claim ("oldest in the state") with no source, used to argue the work is more urgent here than anywhere else.

fenwick-street-notice.md.quote: No amount of lead in drinking water is safe for a child.
fenwick-street-notice.md.issue: A block quotation with no attribution or source.

fenwick-street-notice.md.quote: will take six weeks, finishing by 9 May
fenwick-street-notice.md.issue: 14 April to 9 May is under four weeks, not six.
The project cost conflicts with the $2.4 million budget given in the previous sentence.

quillon-frost-report.md.quote: any fruit region can recover fully from a total crop loss within three years
quillon-frost-report.md.issue: The report's central conclusion generalizes from one valley with no supporting evidence, and the loss described was 70%, not total; the closing section needs reworking.

quillon-frost-report.md.quote: Crop insurance covered about 40% of growers' losses.
quillon-frost-report.md.issue: A statistic with no source, in a paragraph where the other figures are sourced.
41,000 tonnes is about 3.4 times 12,000 tonnes, not five times.

quillon-frost-report.md.quote: which proves that wind machines prevent frost damage
quillon-frost-report.md.issue: Overstated causal claim: one season without losses does not prove wind machines prevent frost damage.

quillon-frost-report.md.quote: Quillon Valley is now the largest apple-growing region in the country.
quillon-frost-report.md.issue: A record claim ("largest in the country") with no source.

quillon-frost-report.md.quote: the frost taught us more in one night than our parents learned in forty years.
quillon-frost-report.md.issue: A quotation attributed only to "growers", with no named speaker or source.
The frost date conflicts with the earlier, sourced date of 19 April 2021.
